jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team
Metronome is a usage-based billing platform and a Stripe product. It helps modern software companies launch products faster, offer flexible pricing models, and streamline finance workflows.
The Metronome Integration Engineering team sits at the intersection of sales, growth, product, and research and development. We own the technical aspects of the customer lifecycle after a sale and before the customer transitions to our post-implementation teams.

What you'll do
As an Integration Engineer, you’ll help customers implement Metronome successfully and realize value quickly. You’ll lead technical work across requirements gathering, solution and integration design, configuration, testing, data migration, launch, and handoff.

Responsibilities

• Conduct discovery and scoping to understand customers’ challenges across billing, product launches, pricing and packaging, quote-to-cash, customer experience, and related areas.

• Support customers throughout the implementation lifecycle, including requirements gathering, technical design, integration design, testing, data migration, and launch.

• Provide expert guidance on usage-based pricing and consumption-based business models.

• Configure Metronome’s platform on behalf of customers.

• Design integrations between Metronome’s APIs and customers’ business systems—including CRM and CPQ platforms, payment and tax systems, ERP and billing providers, and reporting and analytics tools—in alignment with Metronome best practices.

• Serve as a liaison between customers and Metronome’s research and development teams, advocating for customer needs and feature requests.

• Partner with implementation managers and other project-team members to provide visibility into progress and proactively identify risks and issues.

• Build relationships across customer organizations, from day-to-day operators to C-suite executives. Meet customers in person when doing so will improve the engagement.

• Advise customers on integrating Metronome into their systems and help shape their pricing and packaging strategies.

• Ensure an effective handoff to Customer Success and Technical Support.

You’ll work with some of Metronome’s most strategic customers. These engagements will be complex, deep, and highly technical. Metronome directly influences how modern software companies monetize their products, and this team is on the front lines of that work.
Metronome operates with a startup mindset within Stripe. There is a significant opportunity for people with initiative to influence our direction, build processes from zero to one, and make a meaningful impact.

Who you are
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements below. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are helpful but not required.

• 10+ years of experience in technical or customer-facing roles involving SaaS products, such as sales engineering, solutions architecture, technical account management, or deployment strategy.

• Experience leading complex implementations for enterprise technology companies.

• Experience working in fast-moving environments that value initiative and ownership.

• Ability to quickly learn and communicate technical concepts to technical, go-to-market, and finance stakeholders.

• Interest in building and improving go-to-market playbooks, processes, and reusable assets.

• Ability to travel approximately 30% of the time, depending on customer needs.

Preferred qualifications

• Deep knowledge of quote-to-cash processes, including experience integrating with or working alongside platforms such as Salesforce, NetSuite, CPQ systems, and the Stripe ecosystem.

• Experience as a software engineer, product manager, or in another technical role.

• Strong understanding of project- and program-management fundamentals.

• Experience working with stakeholders in finance, engineering, product, sales operations, or billing operations.

• Experience with logs, metrics, billing, finance, infrastructure, or financial tooling and concepts.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Intern
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe
Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible.
Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.

What you’ll do
As an intern at Stripe you’ll work on projects across our stack that directly impact the way millions of businesses operate. You’ll own problems end to end with the support of your manager and teammates. It’s an opportunity to work alongside some of the most creative and technically rigorous engineers in the industry and learn how to ship high-quality work at scale. By contributing to Stripe’s codebase you’ll work across domains that give you insight into how the global economy works. Recent intern projects include expanding Stripe’s Payments Foundation Model capabilities to improve generalized anomaly detection, building more approachable fraud controls, creating safer payouts, and developing user-facing solutions that prevent costly pricing mistakes and make merchant checkout setup easier.
Our internship program is competitive and the expectations are high.

Responsibilities

• Operate as a real member of the team you join; engage in team discussions, decisions, and the technical design process.

• Write software that will be used in production, and has meaningful impact to Stripe’s business and users.

• Give and receive technical feedback through code reviews or design discussions

• Collaborate with other engineers and cross-functional stakeholders to proactively seek and incorporate feedback.

• Learn quickly by asking great questions, working with your intern manager and teammates effectively, communicating the status of your work clearly, and building with the latest AI tooling.

Who you are

• Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.

• Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before.

• Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.

Minimum requirements

• A strong fundamental understanding of computer science through pursuit of a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, math, or a related discipline.

• Experience and familiarity with programming, either through side projects or classwork. We work mostly in Ruby, Java, Javascript, Go, and Scala. We believe new programming languages can be learned if the fundamentals and general knowledge are present.

• Experience from previous internships or other multi-person projects, including open source contributions, that demonstrate evaluating and receiving feedback from mentors, peers, and stakeholders.

• Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor or subject matter experts.

• Ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate development while applying rigorous critical thinking and professional judgement to review, refine, and validate all outputs.

Preferred qualifications

• At least 1 year of university education, or equivalent work experience.

• One or more areas of specialized knowledge (frontend, backend, infrastructure or other technologies) balanced with general skills and knowledge.

• Experience writing high quality pull requests, with good test coverage, and working knowledge to complete projects with minimal defects.

• Familiarity with navigating and managing your work in new code bases, with multiple languages.

• Clear written communication skills, with the ability to write clearly to explain your work to stakeholders, team members, and other Stripes.

The team is looking for a Revenue and Finance Automation specialist with a deep understanding of the order-to-cash process and how modern businesses manage subscription billing, invoicing, and revenue recognition. You will engage with customers as a thought leader in the billing infrastructure space, helping them design solutions on Stripe Billing that reduce churn, improve cash collection, and align their financial operations with accurate revenue recognition under GAAP/IFRS standards.

Responsibilities

• Demonstrate a deep understanding of the order-to-cash process—including subscription and usage-based billing, dunning, proration, and revenue recognition workflows—and how these map to Stripe's platform

• Conduct deep discovery of customers' existing billing architecture and business model to architect solutions that align Stripe's capabilities with their quote-to-cash requirements

• Advise customers on how to design for complexity: mid-cycle upgrades, entitlement management, multi-currency revenue recognition, and integration with ERP systems (NetSuite, Workday, SAP)

• Partner closely with the Billing product sales team and actively drive opportunities for Stripe's largest customers, leading solution strategy and owning key customer relationships

• Support marketing events including executive briefings, conferences, user groups, and trade shows

Who you are
We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 7+ years of experience in a technical sales, pre-sales, or solutions architecture role, with a focus on billing, subscription, or revenue management platforms

• 3+ years of hands-on experience with the order-to-cash process in a SaaS environment, including subscription lifecycle management, dunning, and revenue recognition

• Strong understanding of revenue recognition standards (ASC 606, IFRS 15) and how they apply to SaaS and usage-based business models

• Experience working with or implementing billing and ERP software (NetSuite, Workday, SAP, Zuora, BillingPlatform, or similar)

• Strong knowledge of software engineering and API integration patterns

• Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, comfortable explaining complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

• A proven ability to build strong collaborative working relationships with business partners

• Ability to deal effectively with ambiguity and thrive in an unstructured, fast-moving environment

Preferred qualifications

• Experience integrating Stripe or other RESTful APIs into web applications

• Familiarity with complex billing scenarios: usage-based pricing, tiered models, multi-entity revenue recognition, or hybrid subscription and consumption models

• Experience with CRM platforms and their integration with billing systems

• Experience as a subject matter expert in a relevant industry, vertical, or product

We're hiring a product manager to own Stripe's product strategy and execution across our priority industry verticals, starting with complex, regulated industries like insurance, healthcare, and public sector. We are seeking a highly-entrepreneurial, data-driven product leader who will define where Stripe plays, build 0-to-1 products to unlock new revenue, and influence Stripe's broader Product organization to meet the unique needs of enterprise customers in your vertical. The products you build will directly shape how the world's largest companies use Stripe—and how Stripe grows within one of its most strategic segments.

Responsibilities

• Own the industry product roadmap—Define and execute the multi-year product strategy for your priority vertical. Translate your "where to play and how to win" thesis into a concrete roadmap—deciding what Stripe builds natively, what we solve through platform extensibility, and where we partner. Own measurable outcomes tied to revenue, adoption, and merchant satisfaction.

• Ship 0→1 products—Identify unmet needs through deep customer research, data analysis, and market intelligence. Lead the full product lifecycle for industry-relevant functionality—from problem definition and technical scoping with engineering, through PRD, API and UX design, build, launch, and post-launch iteration. You'll make hands-on trade-off decisions about scope, technical approach, and sequencing with your engineering team.

• Be a strategic partner to GTM and customers—Work deeply with our largest customers, partners, and GTM teams. Translate "market noise" into clear product signal—shaping feature requirements, and defining the data models and integration patterns that enterprise customers in your vertical need.

• Act as a force multiplier across Stripe's platform—Influence Stripe's core product teams (Payments, Billing, Connect, and beyond) to ensure their roadmaps reflect the requirements of enterprise customers in your vertical. To do this credibly, you'll need to go deep on Stripe's platform—understanding our APIs, infrastructure constraints, and extensibility model—so you can advocate for changes with technical specificity, not just business cases.

Who you are
We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 12+ years of product management experience, with a track record of shipping successful products in complex, regulated environments.

• Technical fluency—You don't need to write code, but you're comfortable reading an API spec, reasoning about system design trade-offs, and holding your own in engineering discussions. You've shipped products where the "how we build it" mattered as much as the "what."

• Deep customer obsession—A talent for getting close to customers—talking to merchants and partners—and distilling complex pain points into simple, elegant product requirements.

• Analytical rigor—You use data—not just intuition—to prioritize. You're comfortable defining metrics frameworks, digging into usage data, and making quantitative arguments for (or against) product investments.

• A master communicator—Stripe is a writing-heavy culture. You must be able to articulate deep technical and strategic concepts through precise, persuasive prose—your narrative docs are things of beauty.

• High agency and influence—Adept at finding "homes" for initiatives, building consensus across disparate teams, and driving momentum without needing formal authority.

• Entrepreneurial mindset and bias for action—Comfortable with ambiguity, skilled at prioritizing high-impact initiatives, and experienced operating with limited resources to unlock outsized outcomes.

Preferred qualifications

• Direct experience building products in Healthtech, Insurtech, Public Sector, or similarly complex, regulated industries.

• Experience building platform, API, or developer-facing products.

• Experience working closely with Enterprise Sales teams and C-suite stakeholders at Fortune 500 companies.

job.title: AI Technical Mentor - Independent Contractor (US Canada, Europe, MENA, APAC)
job.description:
About Us
Udacity is now an Accenture company, and exciting things are happening! 🚀 We are on a mission of forging futures in tech through radical talent transformation in digital technologies. We offer a unique and immersive online learning platform, powering corporate technical training in fields such as Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Autonomous Systems, Cloud Computing and more. Our rapidly growing global organization is revolutionizing how the enterprise market bridges the talent shortage and skills gaps during their digital transformation journey.
Recognized for its innovative impact, Udacity part of Accenture continues to empower people with the skills they need to secure the jobs they want.
Our School of Artificial Intelligence is committed to providing high-quality upskilling opportunities in this rapidly evolving field. We regularly launch new projects and are seeking experienced mentors to join us as external contractors to support our programs and learners.
As new initiatives arise, we will reach out to qualified candidates within this talent pool to provide details on project scope, expected timelines, and compensation. If you are passionate about tackling meaningful challenges and making a difference we invite you to apply and explore this opportunity to collaborate with us.
You’ll be an excellent fit if you have:

• Proven technical expertise with 5+ years of experience in Artificial Intelligence or Machine Learning

• A passion for mentoring and helping others succeed in their learning

• Excellent interpersonal skills. You enjoy building relationships, communicating effectively, and fostering a positive learning environment

• A deep understanding of the tech industry and emerging trends in AI and related fields

• The flexibility to work part-time as an external contractor alongside your current commitments

Mandatory Technical Skills – School of AI

• Proficiency in Python and API integration

• Strong understanding of core AI/ML concepts

• Familiarity with LLMs and Generative AI tools

• Experience with prompt engineering and model evaluation

• Working knowledge of ML libraries (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow)

• Exposure to AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex)

• Understanding of RAG, embeddings, and vector databases

• Ability to build or support AI-driven applications/workflows

• Awareness of AI use cases, limitations, and ethics

• Strong problem-solving and communication skills

Preferred:

• Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)

• Hands-on end-to-end AI/ML or GenAI projects

Responsibilities:
Your responsibilities as a technical mentor will be divided into three major tasks.

• 1:1 video calls

• Virtual Technical Deep-Dive Sessions

• Group Q&A sessions

Personal 1:1 Session:

• Provide personalized support by addressing learner questions related to course content and projects.

• Prior to the call mentors are expected to review the students' previous project submission(s) - provided by the Mentor Success Team when available - and/or any specific areas of the Nanodegree content or project that the student has expressed confusion or difficulty with.

Technical Deep-Dive Session:

• For concept deep-dives, mentors will come prepared with a slide presentation that reviews a Nanodegree concept in more detail, share different use-cases for the concept to broaden student perspectives and understanding, and hold a Q&A session with the learners.

• For project walkthroughs, a mentor will come prepared with a slide presentation that outlines each element of the rubric to help learners understand expectations and typical problem areas they may encounter. This can include a mentor “grading” a sample submission to demonstrate what mentors are looking for when reviewing projects.

Group Q&A Session:

• Host regular sessions (via Slack or video) to address learner queries related to projects and coursework. No prior preparation required.

Why should you apply?

• Make an impact by mentoring and contributing to a vibrant, global learning community

• Showcase your expertise and gain recognition for your technical knowledge

• Learn and network with our global community of mentors while staying ahead of the curve on cutting-edge technologies

• Earn additional income with the flexibility to work on your own schedule

Mentoring at Udacity offers a unique opportunity to make a significant impact on the lives of learners and to contribute to achieving our mission.
If you're passionate about learning, technology and want to make a positive impact, we encourage you to apply to become a mentor at Udacity part of Accenture.
Let's work together to shape the future of tech education!
Compensation at Udacity, an Accenture company, varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to location, role, skill set, and level of experience. As required by local law, Udacity, an Accenture company, will provide a reasonable range of compensation.
We believe that no one should be discriminated against because of their differences. All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law. Our rich diversity makes us more innovative, more competitive, and more creative, which helps us better serve our clients and our communities.
Accenture Equal Opportunity Statement
Udacity, an Accenture company, is an EEO and Affirmative Action Employer of Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities, and is committed to providing veteran employment opportunities to our service men and women.
Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States. Candidates who are currently employed by a client of Accenture or an affiliated Accenture business may not be eligible for consideration. Job candidates will not be obligated to disclose sealed or expunged records of conviction or arrest as part of the hiring process. Further, at Accenture a criminal conviction history is not an absolute bar to employment.

Udacity's Values
Obsess over Outcomes - Take the Lead - Embrace Curiosity - Celebrate the Assist
Udacity's Terms of Use and Privacy Policy

job.title: Product Manager, Finance Operations
job.description:
Who we are

About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team
Stripe’s Financial Systems organization builds the technology that enables Stripe’s Finance org to operate accurately, efficiently, and at Stripe’s scale. We develop trusted data products, internal platforms and products, and intelligent workflows that help Finance teams manage complex global operations while maintaining strong controls.
This role will join a product team focused on transforming finance operations. You will initially work closely with Stripe’s tax and treasury organizations with opportunities for future impact in other parts of the Finance org. The products you build will help experts find trusted information, coordinate work, identify exceptions, and make timely decisions without stitching together context and workflows across multiple systems.

What you’ll do
You will develop products that will enable Stripe to maintain a continuously updated understanding of financial performance, automate complex operations while maintaining rigorous financial controls that minimize risk, and reduce toil for domain experts to free them for higher-value work. You will develop a deep understanding of expert users and their workflows, own the product strategy, turn it into a focused roadmap, and lead products from discovery through adoption and continuous improvement. The transformation your products enable will reduce risk, improve efficiency, automate manual tasks, and better enable Stripe to make timely financial decisions, deliver on regulatory commitments, and run a global-scale business.
This role combines internal product development, data platforms, automated workflow design, and applied AI. You will help develop purpose-built solutions, platforms, and autonomous agentic capabilities that reason over governed data, drive end-to-end workflows, and support expert decisions. Success requires understanding the capabilities and limitations of AI and machine learning when applied to business-critical, regulated, and strictly governed problems. You will also use AI-enabled tools throughout the product development lifecycle to accelerate discovery, prototyping, requirements development, evaluation, and iteration without compromising quality or controls.

Responsibilities

• Develop a deep understanding of Finance users, jobs-to-be-done, compliance and regulatory considerations, and data dependencies, then translate that understanding into a clear roadmap for agentic automations.

• Own products end to end, from problem discovery and strategy through delivery, adoption, measurement, and iteration

• Build reusable data and self-serve workflow capabilities that eliminate manual overhead and enable future automated Finance use cases

• Partner with Finance, engineering, data, security, legal, and others to make sound product and architecture tradeoffs in a business-critical and control-sensitive environment

• Define measures to understand adoption, engagement, and impact for products and develop insights into the metrics to guide improvements to the product

• Develop Finance products that enable Stripes to self-serve the creation and operation of agentic automations, while establishing appropriate boundaries for autonomous execution, evaluation methods, and controls for human review

• Use AI-enabled tools throughout product development and help establish effective practices for AI-assisted discovery, prototyping, specification, testing, and iteration

• Balance new product development with reliability, operational ownership, and the long-term health of the portfolio

Who you are
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 5+ years of product management or equivalent experience leading the development of complex software products

• Experience independently taking a product from problem discovery through launch, adoption, measurement, and iteration

• Experience working closely with engineering and data teams on systems involving data models, integrations, APIs, or complex operational workflows

• Demonstrated ability to synthesize the needs of multiple user groups and lead decisions across organizational boundaries

• Ability to communicate clearly about product strategy, priorities, tradeoffs, risks, and results with both technical and nontechnical partners

Preferred qualifications

• Experience building products for tax, treasury, accounting, regulatory reporting, or other control-sensitive domains

• Experience with enterprise data platforms, workflow systems, internal tool development, or systems of record

• Experience applying AI or automation to expert workflows while preserving human review, auditability, and accountability

• Experience maturing a product from active development into a reliable, sustainable operating model

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to support the Digital Health Data Platform (DHDP) by driving CI/CD, infrastructure automation, deployment, environment configuration, monitoring, and operational support across DEV, QA, PRE-PROD, and PROD. In this role, you will work closely with Data Engineering, Data Architecture, Cloud/Infrastructure, Security, and QA teams to ensure DHDP changes are deployed securely, consistently, and according to established architecture, security, and change-management requirements.

Responsibilities

• Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines across DHDP environments

• Automate deployment and controlled promotion across DEV, QA, PRE-PROD, and PROD

• Maintain environment-specific deployment configuration and parameters

• Ensure deployments are version-controlled, repeatable, traceable, and auditable

• Troubleshoot deployment and pipeline failures

• Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code, preferably using Terraform, to automate provisioning and configuration of DHDP Azure resources

• Maintain reusable infrastructure modules and minimize configuration drift

• Support DHDP services including Azure Databricks, ADLS Gen2, Key Vault, Event Hubs, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB integrations, Monitor / Log Analytics, and Purview components

• Collaborate with Cloud teams on networking, DNS, Private Endpoints, and shared infrastructure

• Automate deployment of Databricks jobs, workflows, notebooks, data pipelines, and configuration, and implement and maintain Databricks Asset Bundles

• Support compute and Unity Catalog configuration, as well as Service Principals and Managed Identities used for Databricks automation

• Integrate CI/CD with Microsoft Entra ID, Managed Identities, Service Principals, and Azure Key Vault, applying least-privilege principles to deployment identities

• Ensure credentials and secrets are securely managed and not stored in source code

• Support automation of DHDP access-control configuration where applicable

• Maintain deployment consistency across all DHDP environments and support release promotion, configuration validation, rollback, and recovery

• Ensure production data and credentials remain isolated from non-production environments

• Support DHP/DHDP change-control processes and maintain deployment evidence

• Implement monitoring and alerting using Azure Monitor and Log Analytics, and monitor Databricks jobs, deployments, and infrastructure

• Troubleshoot operational issues and support root-cause analysis

• Maintain Git-based development and Pull Request workflows

Requirements

• 3+ years of experience as a DevOps Engineer, with hands-on expertise in Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps / GitHub CI/CD, and Terraform / Infrastructure as Code

• Experience with Azure Databricks and Databricks Asset Bundles

• Proficiency in Git and Pull Request workflows

• Knowledge of Azure Key Vault, Microsoft Entra ID, Managed Identities, and Service Principals

• Familiarity with Azure Monitor / Log Analytics, Azure networking, and Private Endpoints

• Skills in PowerShell, Bash, and/or Python

• Understanding of multi-environment deployment and cloud security practices

• Proficiency in English at a B2+ level

Nice to have

• Experience with Unity Catalog, ADLS Gen2, and PostgreSQL

• Familiarity with Cosmos DB and Event Hubs

• Knowledge of Microsoft Purview and Power BI integration

job.description:
Position Title: Contract Instructor - Cybersecurity, Incident Response & Hands-On Training

Area: USA, APAC, EMEA, LATAM
Location/Work type: Remote: Virtual and in-person classes
Do you love cybersecurity and thrive on helping organizations strengthen their security posture and build resilient defense teams? Pluralsight ’s Instructor-Led Training (ILT) team is seeking exceptional Independent Contract Cybersecurity Instructors and Scenario Developers to deliver engaging, high-impact training experiences for Fortune 500 clients. This opportunity allows you to lead live, instructor-led sessions both in-person and virtually, empowering technical and leadership teams through interactive Tabletop Exercises (TTX) and competitive Capture the Flag (CTF) events. Pluralsight offers many ILT solutions including: short workshops, 1–5 day classes, immersive security academies, and blended learning solutions. With topics ranging from incident response workflows to hands-on Red/Blue/Purple team exercises, you will guide learners through structured, real-world instruction that drives immediate security impact. With flexible scheduling, competitive daily rates, and the ability to work from anywhere, this role is ideal for experienced security professionals who are passionate about sharing knowledge and elevating teams.

Who you're committed to being:

• A passionate educator who believes cybersecurity learning should be practical, engaging, and transformational.

• A confident communicator who can bridge the gap between high-level incident response strategy and hands-on technical skill-building for diverse audiences.

• A continuous learner who stays current with emerging threats, evolving exploit mechanics, and modern security frameworks.

• A collaborative partner who works closely with client stakeholders and Pluralsight teams to evaluate security readiness and ensure exceptional delivery.

• A professional who demonstrates reliability, adaptability, and a strong commitment to learner and organizational success.

What you'll do:

• Deliver live instructor-led cybersecurity training, interactive Tabletop Exercises (TTX), and Capture the Flag (CTF) events (both virtual and onsite) for enterprise clients.

• Design industry-tailored threat scenarios, author CTF challenges, and set up vulnerable lab or sandbox environments.

• Facilitate decision-making workflows, post-exercise debriefs (hotwashes), and technical walkthroughs that reinforce defensive remediation strategies.

• Stay current on emerging threat landscapes, MITRE ATT&CK TTPs, and industry security standards.

• Represent Pluralsight professionally while creating an engaging, inclusive, and high-energy learning environment.

• Actively monitor our Instructor Portal to accept/decline class opportunities and communicate timely with Pluralsight project managers.

Experience you'll bring:

• 5+ years of hands-on professional experience in cybersecurity (e.g., Incident Response, SOC/Threat Hunting, Penetration Testing, or Security Engineering).

• 2+ years of experience facilitating technical training, hosting CTFs, or leading incident response tabletop exercises.

• Deep expertise in one or more of the following areas:

• Tabletop Exercise (TTX) Design & Executive/Technical Facilitation

• CTF Challenge Development (Web Security, Forensics, Reverse Engineering, Binary Exploitation)

• Threat Frameworks (MITRE ATT&CK, NIST IR, OWASP Top 10)

• Incident Response Playbooks, Workflows, & After-Action Reporting (AAR)

• Offensive/Defensive Tooling & Scripting (Python, Bash, Wireshark, Splunk, Burp Suite, Metasploit)

• Cloud & Infrastructure Security Sandboxing (Docker, CTFd, Cloud Environments)

• Strong presentation skills with the ability to engage both executive leadership and technical engineering teams.

• Experience delivering security-focused workshops virtually and/or in person to enterprise clients is highly preferred.

Requirements:

• Minimum 5 years of hands-on cybersecurity experience.

• Minimum 2 years of instructional, training, or workshop facilitation experience.

• Ability to deliver training sessions virtually and travel onsite as needed.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills.

• Reliable high-speed internet and professional home office setup for virtual delivery.

• Legal authorization to work as an Independent Contractor.

• Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field preferred (or equivalent professional experience).

• Relevant cybersecurity certifications (e.g., CISSP, GCIH, OSCP, CEH, GRID, Security+) are a plus but not required.

Pluralsight provides the only learning platform dedicated to accelerating the technology skills and capabilities of today’s tech workforce. Thousands of companies, government organizations and individuals around the world rely on Pluralsight to support critical technology skill development in areas that are crucial to innovation including artificial intelligence, cloud computing, cybersecurity, software development, and machine learning. Pluralsight provides highly curated content developed by vetted technology experts, industry leading skill assessments, and hands on, immersive learning experiences designed to help individuals skill-up faster.

Physical Requirements:
This role is primarily performed in an office or home office setting and involves standard computer-based work.

EEOC & Accommodations Statement:
Bring yourself. Pluralsight is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, or veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with EEOC guidelines and local laws.
If you need an accommodation to apply, interview, or perform essential job functions, please visit the bottom of our website to learn how to request an accommodation. Learn more about our commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in our DEIB Report.

Recruiting Scam Notice:
Please be aware of recruiting scams. We’ll only contact you from an @pluralsight.com email or verified channels. We never ask for sensitive personal info or payments as part of the hiring process. All openings are posted on our Careers page.

job.title: Developer Research Coordinator (Contract)
job.description:
AI is changing how we solve problems with software. But some fundamentals remain. Whether the audience is an experienced developer, a newly minted builder, or a coding agent, there is often a gap between what a team assumes will work and what its users can understand, adopt, and use successfully.
MLH’s Developer Intelligence Network exists to bridge that gap. Using quantitative research, such as surveys, and qualitative research, such as interviews, we give technology companies insights that help them decide what to build, how to bring it to market, and where the developer experience needs to improve.
As our Developer Research Coordinator , you will help make that research possible. You will coordinate studies, manage our developer participant panel, and turn raw research material into organized, analysis-ready evidence. You’ll learn developer experience research by doing it while supporting companies ranging from startups to some of the world’s best-known technology brands.
Major League Hacking ’s mission is to empower hackers. Each year, more than 100,000 young technologists and innovators around the world attend MLH events and join our community. MLH recently acquired DEV (dev.to), an online community for software developers. Together, our ecosystem supports millions of creators at every stage of their journey.

What you'll do:

• Coordinate research studies, including participant invitations, scheduling, reminders, follow-ups, and other logistics from start to finish.

• Support roughly one substantive study each month, typically involving 10–20 participants.

• Keep overlapping stages of research moving, including recruiting for upcoming studies, coordinating active fieldwork, and processing recently completed research.

• Clean transcripts, organize responses, tag useful quotes, and identify initial themes and patterns using established LLM-assisted workflows.

• Review AI-generated outputs critically, verify themes against the source material, and flag conclusions that are inaccurate, overstated, or unsupported.

• Produce an analysis-ready evidence pack for each study that the lead researcher can interpret and turn into final findings.

• Run the developer panel day to day, including recruitment, onboarding, profile maintenance, participant matching, regular communication, and responding to participant questions.

• Test onboarding experiences, documentation, code examples, and developer workflows, recording points of confusion or friction.

• Support the quarterly MLH Census, including processing and conducting initial analysis across thousands of responses.

Requirements

• Organized and reliable, with the ability to take ownership of a defined piece of work and keep it moving without being chased.

• Able to manage research participant logistics from beginning to end.

• Experienced using LLMs to work through qualitative material and able to evaluate their output critically rather than accepting it at face value.

• Comfortable navigating developer tools, documentation, GitHub, and code well enough to understand what research participants are describing. Experience with a particular programming language or technology stack is not required.

• Genuinely interested in developer tools, developer relations, technical education, online communities, or how people learn and build with technology.

• A clear, proactive communicator who is comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

• Available to overlap with UK working hours for a few hours each workday.

• Bonus: Experience supporting research studies, surveys, interviews, focus groups, participant panels, or community programs

• Bonus: Familiarity with MLH or DEV, community management experience, and comfort writing code or experimenting with developer tools

Compensation, Hours and Location

•
Weekly commitment: ~20 hours per week

• Location: This is a fully remote opportunity open to candidates globally who can overlap with UK working hours for at least a few hours each workday.

• Compensation: The hourly rate will vary by location and will reflect the successful candidate’s experience and local market.

job.title: Customer Success Manager (EMEA & APAC)
job.description:
Precoro is an innovative AI-powered procurement centralization & automation B2B SaaS platform, helping companies eliminate manual tasks and control purchasing activities across all subsidiaries. With over 1,000 customers in more than 80 countries, Precoro has proven its ability to create real business value and deliver substantial cost savings.
We are expanding our Customer Success team and looking for a Customer Success Manager to drive long-term value, build trust-based relationships, and foster a culture of customer advocacy across our EMEA & APAC B2B accounts.
💡 Why is this role important to us?
The main purpose of this role is to proactively help clients achieve their business goals using Precoro. As a strategic post-go-live partner, you will ensure high customer satisfaction, maximize retention, drive portfolio expansion, and turn our clients into active brand advocates.

Requirements
🎯 Key Responsibilities:

• Strategic Onboarding & Retention: Partner with Implementation Specialists to ensure smooth onboarding, monitor account health, and proactively prevent churn.

• Account Growth & Renewals: Drive contract renewals, upsells, and cross-sells, conducting Executive Business Reviews (EBRs) and joint success plans.

• Consulting & Feature Adoption: Guide clients on procurement best practices, workflow redesign, and adoption of new modules and integrations.

• Training & Enablement: Train key stakeholders, primary contacts (POCs), and power users to maximize platform value.

• Voice of Customer & Advocacy: Gather product feedback for internal teams (Product, Sales, Marketing) and drive client advocacy (case studies, referrals).

• Community & Operational Excellence: Lead webinars and roundtables while maintaining HubSpot CRM accuracy and optimizing internal CSM processes.

🔍 What We Are Looking For:

• Proven Experience: Background in Customer Success or Account Management within a B2B SaaS environment, managing long-term customer partnerships over years (rather than short-term project-based work).

• Mindset & Ownership: You don't just ask "how"—you dig deep into "why." Driven by high curiosity, proactivity, personal accountability, and strong time management skills.

• Exceptional Communication: Fluent English (C1+, both written and verbal) with strong presentation skills and the natural ability to engage in smooth, confident small talk.

• Commercial Acumen: Understanding that CS is a revenue driver (not technical support). Comfortable discussing pricing, contract renewals, and upsells.

• Resilience & Problem-Solving: Ability to handle uncomfortable customer discussions, navigate complex accounts, and find creative solutions.

✨ Why you’ll love working at Precoro:

• Trust-based management: No micromanagement—your ideas and initiatives are always encouraged.

• Supportive team culture: You’re not alone; our team is open, honest, and always ready to help.

• Reimbursement for professional learning: We invest in your growth through courses, lectures, and workshops.

• Flexible hours: We care about results, not how long you sit at your desk.

• 26 days off annually: 15 vacation days + 11 public holidays.

• Medical insurance: Available after six months.

• Unlimited sick leave: No medical certificate required. Your health matters most.

• Pet-friendly offices in Kyiv: Love your furry friend? Bring them along!

• Supporting Ukraine: We proudly assist the Armed Forces and contribute to projects that bring victory closer.

📋 What to Expect:

•
HR Interview (45 min)

•
Practical Test Task

• Interview with the Hiring Manager (60 min)

•
Job Offer & Welcome to the Team! 🚀

We truly appreciate every application, but we will reach out only to candidates whose profiles align with the role requirements.

job.title: Head of Enterprise Sales, West
job.description:
Who we are

About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team
The Enterprise West Sales team engages with some of the largest and fastest-growing businesses in the world to take advantage of Stripe’s solutions. You'll lead and coach high-performing sales executives dispersed along the West Coast, helping them deliver on ambitious targets, as well as roll up your sleeves to work directly with prospective Stripe customers.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities

• Recruit, mentor, develop, and lead a team of sales professionals while scaling our New York GTM presence.

• Train the team in up-leveling professional skills such as collaborative pipeline generation, consultative and solution-based selling, closing tactics, adoption of MEDDIIC, and serving as a Trust Advisor to Stripe Users.

• Develop both the long-term vision and strategy for the team and manage day-to-day operations.

• Be accountable for operating net revenue and activation targets to grow Stripe’s revenue profitably.

• Effectively work cross-functionally across the organization to shape Stripe’s solutions to meet client needs.

• Inspire, motivate and enable individual development to promote career growth of direct reports.

job.title: Policy Lead, AI Infrastructure
job.description:
Who we are

About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team
The Policy team works to understand and shape the regulatory and political environment in which Stripe operates — advising on product and business strategy, developing Stripe's policy positions, and engaging with policymakers and regulators around the world. The Policy Development & Strategy team sits at the center of this work, connecting Policy to Stripe's product and business teams and ensuring the company can pursue a proactive, coordinated policy agenda.
Millions of businesses use Stripe as a core platform to build and grow their own businesses, and increasingly that means building with AI. As AI becomes central to how businesses are built and run, this raises new questions: how infrastructure for AI should operate, what responsibilities sit at the infrastructure layer, and how to keep that infrastructure open, secure, and trusted.

What you’ll do
We are looking for a public policy professional to define Stripe’s approach to these questions and carry it into the world. In this role, you will develop Stripe’s positions on the public policy issues raised by AI infrastructure and help set the principles behind how Stripe’s AI platforms are governed, including trust, safety, and supportability. You will engage policymakers, regulators, industry groups, civil society, and other partners on these issues, in partnership with Stripe’s Government Relations team.
The right person will be equally comfortable working through a hard policy question with Product and Legal teams, briefing senior leaders, and representing Stripe's position with regulators or industry coalitions.

Responsibilities

• Develop Stripe's policy strategy for AI infrastructure. Identify existing and emerging public policy issues and develop substantive positions and priorities that advance Stripe’s interests and reflect our values.

• Shape platform policy principles. Work with the cross-functional teams that own day-to-day enforcement to set the principles and frameworks behind platform governance, acceptable use, model listing, and escalation, while preserving the benefits of neutral and open infrastructure.

• Drive cross-functional alignment. Bring Product, Legal, Comms, Risk, Operations, and Government Relations to shared positions and priorities, and advance work from open question to decision to external execution.

• Advise the business on difficult policy choices. Identify emerging risks and opportunities, translate external policy developments into product and business-model implications, and make recommendations on launches, supportability questions, public commitments, and other high-stakes decisions.

• Develop Stripe's external policy positions. Turn internal policy work into external policy positions on AI infrastructure regulation in the US and globally: US AI policy at the federal and state level, national-security and export-control regimes, the EU AI Act, and emerging rules and standards for AI intermediaries and providers.

• Engage externally on the substance. Engage policymakers, regulators, national security agencies, industry groups, standards bodies, academics, civil society, and other stakeholders to understand and anticipate policy developments; help build relationships and coalitions; and work with the Government Relations team to proactively shape policy debates.

• Lead proactive public-policy initiatives and partnerships. Identify opportunities for Stripe to convene stakeholders, support research, develop industry frameworks, or partner with external organizations on difficult AI-governance and trust-and-safety questions.

• Develop narratives and executive materials. Produce data-driven policy briefs, consultation responses, talking points, presentations, and executive communications that use Stripe’s data to turn technically and legally complex questions into clear positions for internal and external audiences.

Who you are
We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 8+ years of experience in public policy, platform policy, trust and safety, technology policy, government, or a related field.

• Strong policy judgment and a track record of developing positions on complex, contested issues where the legal or regulatory answer is not obvious.

• Meaningful familiarity with trust and safety, platform governance, or online-service policy, including how policy choices translate into product and operational decisions.

• Strong public-policy instincts and experience engaging policymakers, regulators, industry groups, or other external stakeholders.

• Familiarity with AI policy and governance, and the range to engage credibly on fast-moving technical and regulatory questions.

• Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional work across Product, Legal, Operations, Comms, and business teams.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication, including the ability to produce concise policy analysis and represent a position credibly with senior internal and external audiences.

• Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward building: this role will often require creating a position, framework, or external strategy where none exists.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience at a technology or AI company, government agency, think tank, or civil-society organization working on AI, platform governance, trust and safety, or technology policy

• Familiarity with national-security, export-control, or cybersecurity policy; familiarity with payments or internet infrastructure

• JD, MPP, or equivalent advanced degree.

You’ll lead activities to improve risk management interactions between Stripe and its partners, manage key aspects of partner relationships, and execute high-impact initiatives.
You’ll work closely with internal and external stakeholders to set objectives, coordinate priorities, and drive execution. Internally, you’ll coordinate with product and engineering teams, as well as Risk, Fraud, Financial Crime & Supportability, Operations, Legal, and Finance. Externally, you’ll work closely with partners’ risk and compliance teams, including senior management.

job.title: Solutions Architect, Metronome (AI Native)
job.description:
Who we are

About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team
Metronome is the leading usage-based billing platform built for modern software companies. With Metronome, now a Stripe product, companies can launch products faster, offer any pricing model, and streamline finance workflows without writing code.
Our platform computes hundreds of millions of invoices per billing period and continues to scale rapidly to accommodate new customers. We save them days of development time and manual invoicing, enabling them to use their billing data to better serve their customers. Our customers love our product and approach, and we’re humbled to work with amazing companies like OpenAI, Anthropic, NVIDIA, TogetherAI, HuggingFace, and many others.
You'll be joining an experienced team that includes founders who have successfully built and sold startups before. Our Stripes have direct experience building and scaling teams through massive growth at companies like Dropbox, Palantir, and MongoDB. You'll be joining Stripe and be part of the holistic Stripe platform approaching monetization.

What you’ll do
The Metronome AI Native Solutions team operates at the intersection of technical sales, implementation, and customer success, purpose-built for the velocity and unique needs of AI-first companies. Unlike traditional sales engineering roles, this position owns the large parts of if not all of the deal cycle - from first call through technical win - and gets hands-on with implementation to ensure customers go live quickly.
As an AI Native Solutions Architect, you'll be the primary technical owner for fast-moving AI companies that may need to launch usage-based billing on tight timelines. This means:
Owning the technical win:

• Taking qualified inbound leads and driving them through discovery, demo, POC, and technical win

• Using efficient discovery to quickly understand billing challenges, product launch timelines, and technical requirements

• Bringing energy and urgency to every engagement—proactively driving deals forward, identifying blockers early, and building relationships across the customer organization (engineering, finance, product) to create champions

• Running streamlined demos tailored to technical founders and product/engineering teams

Driving hands-on implementation:

• Providing customers with clear, actionable implementation plans to implement their usage-based billing launches

• Writing code snippets, configuration examples, and integration guides to accelerate customer time-to-value

• Pair programming or working alongside customer teams during POCs and initial setup

• Designing up/downstream integrations into prospect systems with a bias toward pragmatic solutions that get them live quickly

Building deep AI market expertise:

• Building relationships with technical founders, engineering leaders, product, and finance teams at AI companies

• Understanding the unique monetization challenges facing LLM providers, generative AI companies (image, video, audio), and AI tooling/wrapper companies and providing consultative guidance when prospects need direction on pricing and packaging strategy and implementation

• Staying current on AI industry trends, pricing models, and competitive dynamics

This role is perfect for someone who thrives in high-velocity environments, loves solving technical problems in real-time, and wants to be on the front lines of how AI companies monetize their products. Metronome directly influences how the next generation of AI infrastructure gets built—and our AI Native Solutions team drives this influence with our fastest-growing customer segment.
The Metronome team still operates very much like a startup. As such, there's a lot still to figure out and tremendous room for high-agency, curious individuals to impact our direction and strategy, build processes from zero to one, and generally make a difference. If this excites you as much as it excites us, let's talk.

Who you are
This is roughly the set of things we’re looking for - if you’re interested in this role and don’t meet some of these on paper, err on the side of applying!

Minimum requirements

• 10+ years of experience in technical, customer-facing roles involving SaaS products (for example, sales engineering, solutions architecture, technical account management, implementation consulting)

• Experience working with, at, or selling to AI companies - you understand how AI-first companies operate, their unique challenges, and the market landscape

• Proven ability to own and drive customer-facing engagements and relationships independently

• Strong technical aptitude with the ability to quickly learn new systems, write code snippets, and guide technical implementations

• Experience working in high-velocity environments where speed-to-value matters and customers need to launch quickly

• Excellent communication skills with technical buyers (engineers, product managers, technical founders)

Preferred qualifications

• Deep knowledge of the quote-to-cash space, including integrating with or otherwise interacting with tools like Salesforce, NetSuite, CPQs, etc.

• Experience as a software engineer, product manager, or in other technical roles.

• Experience in a pure sales role, particularly selling to technical buyers in engineering and product organizations or selling as a founding or early salesperson at a startup.

• Familiarity and enthusiasm for AI developer tooling (Cursor, Lovable, Vercel, LangChain, etc.) and the broader AI infrastructure ecosystem

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of AI monetization at one of the world's leading fintech companies. Join us in defining how the next generation of AI businesses will scale and succeed.

Strategic Accounts Solutions Architecture serves Stripe’s most complex and consequential users. The team combines deep technical expertise, commercial judgment, and customer empathy to solve problems that often have no established playbook. Its work not only helps individual users grow; it also surfaces emerging needs and opportunities that can inform Stripe’s product strategy and create value for users at global scale. These Solution Architects are deeply embedded in these users and are working along as their technical co-founders.
The Head of Strategic Accounts, Solutions Architecture will lead a team of senior architects who are trusted partners to strategic, key, and major accounts. This leader will set the vision for the team, develop exceptional technical talent, and work closely with account leadership to deepen and grow Stripe’s most important relationships. They will also build a strong partnership with Product and Engineering, turning insights from leading-edge customer engagements into the next wave of innovation across Stripe.
This is a highly technical, hands-on leadership role. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between executive conversations, account strategy, architecture reviews, product discussions, and direct support for the team’s most complex engagements. They will be AI-enabled in how they lead and operate, highly curious about new technologies and business models, and committed to helping their team and Stripe continuously raise the bar.

What You’ll Do

Responsibilities

• Set the vision, strategy, and operating model for Strategic Accounts Solutions Architecture, aligning the team’s priorities with Stripe’s user, product, and business objectives.

• Recruit, lead, coach, and retain a world-class team of senior Solutions Architects supporting Stripe’s strategic, key, and major accounts.

• Partner with account leaders to develop and execute technical account strategies that deepen customer relationships, unlock new use cases, and drive durable growth.

• Lead from the front in the team’s most complex and high-impact engagements, including architecture workshops, executive briefings, solution design, technical evaluations, and critical escalations.

• Serve as a trusted technical advisor to senior executives, product leaders, and engineering leaders at the world’s largest and most innovative companies.

• Build a close, durable partnership with Stripe Product and Engineering teams; synthesize patterns from strategic accounts, influence product priorities, and help translate customer needs into scalable capabilities for all Stripe users.

• Create mechanisms for senior architects to share technical insights, reusable patterns, and field learnings across Stripe.

• Establish a culture of technical excellence, curiosity, accountability, experimentation, and continuous learning.

• Champion AI-enabled ways of working across the team, using AI to improve insight generation, solution development, team productivity, and the quality and speed of customer outcomes.

• Develop talent through clear expectations, thoughtful coaching, meaningful feedback, and opportunities for architects to expand their technical, commercial, and leadership impact.

• Collaborate closely with Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Technical Account Management, Partnerships, Marketing, Product, and Engineering to deliver cohesive outcomes for users.

• Build processes and metrics that measure the team’s impact on customer outcomes, account growth, product influence, and organizational effectiveness.

• Anticipate changes in technology, customer needs, competitive dynamics, and industry structure, and translate those signals into action for the team and Stripe.

• Represent Stripe in executive forums, customer business reviews, industry events, and other strategic engagements.

Minimum Requirements

• 6+ years of experience leading technical pre-sales, solutions architecture, sales engineering, or comparable customer-facing architecture teams aligned to strategic, key, or major accounts.

• A track record of hiring, developing, and leading senior technical talent in a complex, high-growth environment.

• Deep technical fluency and the ability to remain hands-on—quickly understanding architectures, APIs, data flows, integration patterns, security and reliability considerations, and emerging technologies.

• Experience partnering directly with senior customer executives, product leaders, and engineering leaders on complex, business-critical initiatives.

• Demonstrated success connecting technical strategy to account growth, customer outcomes, and long-term partnerships.

• Strong experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmaps, shape requirements, and turn customer insights into scalable product innovation.

• An AI-enabled approach to leadership and problem-solving, with practical experience using AI tools to increase the quality, speed, or scale of work.

• Exceptional curiosity and learning agility, including a strong desire to explore new technologies, business models, and ways of working.

• Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to make complex technical and business topics clear to audiences at every level.

• Sound judgment and the ability to lead through ambiguity, balance competing priorities, and make high-quality decisions in fast-moving environments.

• A collaborative leadership style and a demonstrated ability to align stakeholders across Sales, Product, Engineering, and other cross-functional teams.

• Willingness to travel as needed to engage with strategic customers and collaborate with internal teams.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with payments, financial infrastructure, fintech space

We're looking for an experienced Agile Program Manager to lead delivery across multiple cross-functional teams working toward a shared set of business outcomes. You'll sit at the intersection of strategy and execution: translating roadmap priorities into coordinated, predictable delivery, keeping dependencies visible, and making sure the right people are making the right decisions at the right time.
This is a hands-on program role, not a status-reporting one. You'll own the cadence, the plan, and the risks across several Agile teams, and you'll be the person stakeholders trust to tell them where things really stand.

What You'll Do

• Lead end-to-end delivery of a multi-team program, coordinating three or more Agile teams (Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid) toward shared quarterly objectives.

• Run program-level planning, including quarterly/PI planning, roadmap alignment, capacity planning, and release planning.

• Identify, map, and actively manage cross-team dependencies, risks, and blockers, escalating early and with clear options.

• Facilitate program ceremonies such as Scrum of Scrums, program syncs, system demos, and retrospectives, and make sure they produce decisions, not just updates.

• Partner with Product Owners and Product Managers to keep backlogs prioritized, refined, and aligned to business value.

• Build and maintain program-level reporting: delivery health, burn-up/velocity trends, OKR or objective progress, and RAID logs, tailored for both team-level and executive audiences.

• Drive continuous improvement in delivery practices, tooling, and team workflows, coaching teams and leaders on Agile principles where needed.

• Manage stakeholder communication across engineering, product, design, business, and leadership, keeping expectations aligned as scope and priorities shift.

• Track program budget, resourcing, and vendor or third-party deliverables where applicable.

What You Bring

• 8+ years of experience in program or project management, with at least 5 years leading delivery in Agile environments.

• Proven track record managing multi-team programs (not just single-team Scrum) from planning through release.

• Deep, practical knowledge of Scrum and Kanban, plus experience with at least one scaling framework (SAFe, LeSS, Scrum@Scale, or similar).

• Strong command of Agile tooling such as Jira, Jira Align, Azure DevOps, Rally, or equivalent, including building dashboards and program-level reporting.

• Excellent facilitation skills: you can run a 50-person planning event as comfortably as a tense 1:1 escalation.

• Clear, concise written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to tailor the message for engineers and executives alike.

• Experience working with distributed or remote teams across time zones.

• Experience with Agile transformations or introducing scaled frameworks into an organization.

• Background in software, SaaS, data, or digital product delivery.

• Familiarity with OKRs and value-stream or portfolio management.

• Experience in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, insurance, public sector) where Agile delivery coexists with compliance requirements.

• Budget and vendor management experience on programs with multiple delivery partners.

Product Management Intern – Identity Resilience

About the Team & Role
The Product Management team at Rubrik drives forward our vision of delivering a market-leading platform that addresses the world’s most critical cyber resilience and data security challenges.
The Identity Resilience team is Rubrik’s fastest-growing business unit, operating with a high-velocity "0-to-1" charter. Today, modern cyberattacks almost exclusively weaponize identity systems. When identity fails, the entire enterprise halts. Our mission is to ensure enterprise identity environments are secure, observable, compliant, and instantly recoverable.
We are looking for a strategically sharp, technical, and execution-minded Product Management Intern for a high-impact 2-month internship based in Bengaluru. As an intern, you will own a core strategic initiative – bridging enterprise customer pain points, competitive differentiation, and technical architecture to deliver a concrete product roadmap for next-generation identity protection.

What You’ll Do (2-Month Charter)

• Market Landscape & Threat Vector Analysis: Benchmark the enterprise identity attack surface across hybrid environments. Map emerging threat vectors to potential resilience and recovery capabilities.

• Customer Discovery & Pain Point Synthesis: Work alongside PM and GTM mentors to analyze customer requirements, telemetry data, and enterprise security frameworks to pinpoint the highest-friction operational gaps for Security and IAM teams.

• Feature Strategy & PRD Ownership: Define the scope, user workflows, and success metrics for a targeted identity protection/recovery feature. Author a high-quality Product Requirement Document (PRD) balancing enterprise-grade depth with Rubrik’s trademark simplicity.

• Cross-Functional Architecture Alignment: Collaborate closely with Engineering, UX Design, and Architecture leads to evaluate technical trade-offs, define API/data pipeline requirements, and ensure feasibility.

• Executive Strategy Pitch: Conclude your internship with an Executive Product Readout to Senior Leadership, defending your business case, technical trade-offs, and proposed roadmap.

What You’ll Need

• Education: Currently enrolled in a premier MBA/management program (IIM, ISB, or equivalent global top-tier business school) graduating in 2027/28

• Technical Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or an equivalent engineering discipline. Prior product management or technical experience in enterprise systems, cloud platforms, or cybersecurity is a strong plus.

• Systems & Security Thinking: An understanding of enterprise software fundamentals; familiarity with core identity concepts is an advantage.

• Problem Solving: Comfort with ambiguity, structured thinking, and the ability to break complex, undefined problems into crisp, actionable requirements.

• Communication & Influence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate technical trade-offs to senior product and engineering leaders.

• Location: Based in or willing to relocate to Bengaluru for the 2-month internship duration (Hybrid model).

What You’ll Gain

• True 0-to-1 Problem Ownership: Direct ownership of a real-world, high-priority product problem in enterprise cybersecurity – not a back-burner sandbox project.

• High-Stakes Leadership Visibility: Regular 1:1 mentorship from seasoned Product Managers and a final presentation to Product & Engineering leadership.

• Cybersecurity PM Expertise: Hands-on exposure to cutting-edge identity governance, threat modeling, and resilience frameworks inside an enterprise security market leader.

Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation
Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls.

job.title: Commercial Counsel, Bridge
job.description:
Who we are

About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team
Stripe is a global technology company that builds infrastructure for online commerce with a mission to increase the GDP of the internet. Through Bridge, Stripe is building stablecoin infrastructure that helps businesses move, store, and use money globally. This role will support Bridge as it develops and scales products for companies operating across markets.

What you’ll do
Stripe is looking for an exceptional transactional lawyer to join our commercial legal team supporting Bridge and Stripe’s fast-growing stablecoin business.

Responsibilities

• Support Bridge’s commercial team, leading negotiations for complex and strategic user and partner agreements.

• Advise on commercial and legal issues arising from stablecoin products, new product launches, and international expansion.

• Work closely with Product Legal and Bridge’s product and engineering teams to bring new products and features to market.

• Help build Bridge’s commercial legal infrastructure so the business can scale efficiently, including drafting and maintaining agreements and playbooks, improving internal processes, and using AI tooling to optimize how we work with clients, partners, and users.

• Partner with teams across Bridge and Stripe globally, including commercial, operations, product, engineering, tax, compliance, and risk.

• Help the team provide practical, scalable legal support while working collaboratively across a global Commercial Legal team.

• Develop and deliver training and resources to help Bridge’s commercial team sell and support its products.

• Be a point of escalation for outside counsel.

Who you are
We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• Intellectually curious and a creative problem solver - Bridge’s products and the stablecoin industry are complex and fast evolving - you should relish learning new products and finding practical solutions to challenging problems.

• A self-starter with a bias for action - you are proactive and have a strong sense of ownership.

• A clear and concise communicator (in written and verbal forms), who can distill the key risks and explain complex, nuanced issues in plain and simple terms.

• A natural collaborator, able to guide cross-functional teams and drive to a win-win solution.

• Familiar with the legal issues and commercial risks arising from fintech, stablecoin, hosted data, and technology services.

• A team player who is willing to do what it takes to contribute to the collective success.

• Qualified with good standing membership in at least one US state bar with a JD degree or foreign equivalent.

• 5+ years of relevant experience in-house or in a technology practice group in a top law firm.

Preferred qualifications

• E xperience working in payments, fintech, crypto, or stablecoin businesses and knowledge of associated regulatory issues.

• In-house experience advising high-growth companies.

• Working knowledge of LLM tools.

• Experience in improving legal processes with AI technology.

• A working knowledge of data protection laws such as CCPA, GDPR, and HIPAA.

About Stripe
